findings.subject: 6477107346fbc799ffc8ccdb4987de29f474c5c545963f7eecf3b8695ccae481
evidence: For the expressly selected endpoint #(Z^2/J_g^Delta Z^2)=14^Delta, the interpretation faithfully represents the displayed cardinality, rather than the entire determinant chain or all of Lemma 6.2. A fresh extraction has exactly the supplied SHA-256; its line 3599 and every supplied context range match, and original PDF pages 63 and 67 were visually inspected. Frequency is Z x Z; indexMap sends (a,b) to (3a+b,a+5b), precisely the displayed J_g; coverHom iterates it; coverRange is its image; Sheet is the additive quotient. Delta is a nonnegative integer in (6.18); universal quantification over Nat strengthens the bounded application without changing the selected arithmetic assertion. The formal index is definitionally the cardinality of this quotient. All four exact original challenge goals replay successfully under the pinned Lean toolchain, and original TorusCoverLattice.lean was separately freshly elaborated. The interpretation goal alone is only P-implies-P. The first replay had a reviewer tactic mistake at the let binder in conclusion transfer; the unchanged goal passes after reducing that let, so the initial failure is not mathematical evidence. The local assertion is valid: det J_g=14; the quotient has index14 at one step, and injective iteration multiplies indices to14^Delta, including Delta=0. The formal proof establishes its actual premises by an explicit surjective residue map (a,b) -> b-5a mod14, proves its kernel is the image of J_g, proves injectivity, then uses induction. This differs from the prose determinant-index computation, although it proves the same endpoint. The numerical count supports only the counting part of the parent lemma; disjoint-lift identification additionally uses the preceding small-rectangle injectivity, and Haar/operation-preservation claims are not consequences of this obligation and are not certified here. No author verdict, other review, prior diagnosis or excluded material was received; no accidental exposure occurred.
